breakdown.description: The notch faces are turned from traction-free cut surfaces into clamped boundaries
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt contained contradictory instructions for the notch boundaries: first stating they are 'traction-free', and later instructing to 'Clamp... the two notch faces'. The ground truth resolves this by keeping the notch boundaries traction-free. The agent failed to resolve this, instead implementing the incorrect clamping instruction by stating: 'Apply a fixed (zero displacement) boundary condition on the two vertical faces of the notch.'
